# conda env "gpu"  (Python 3.10)
# Runs all four stages: coarse_seg.py, select_targets.py, sam2_masks.py,
# masks_to_labelme.py. The SAM2.1 / osam (onnxruntime) stack lives here too, so
# a single env covers the whole pipeline.
#
# torch/torchvision come from the CUDA wheel index, not PyPI:
#   pip install torch==2.11.0 torchvision==0.26.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
# (swap cu128 for your CUDA; use the CPU index if you have no GPU)

# stage 1 & 4
numpy==2.2.6
opencv-python==4.13.0.92
pillow==12.2.0
torch==2.11.0+cu128
torchvision==0.26.0+cu128

# stage 3 - SAM2.1 via osam / onnxruntime. osam is a plain PyPI package (no torch
# needed); the ONNX weights are downloaded at runtime, see the "SAM2 model
# download" section of ../README.md
osam==0.2.5
onnxruntime==1.19.2

# osam transitive deps, pinned to the versions this pipeline was verified on
click==8.4.2
gdown==6.0.0
imgviz==1.7.6
loguru==0.7.3
pydantic==2.13.4
